judged_text: create abandons the accepted `group: {name, usernames, visible}` request envelope that the deleted specs asserted — it reads only flat params[:name]/params[:visible] and handles no usernames at all, so one-call group creation with initial members no longer exists. Existing API scripts and plugins that POST the old envelope receive a 422 validation error (params[:name] is nil because the payload nests name under :group, so the stripped name is blank) instead of a created group, and API consumers have no replacement for atomic create-with-members since the new admin UI requires create-then-add as two separate calls.

adjudication.rationale: Diff shows a deliberate API shape change in `Admin::GroupsController#create`: it now reads `params[:name]`/`params[:visible]` (flat) and no longer reads `params[:group][:name]`, `params[:group][:usernames]`, or sets initial members (old `group.usernames = ...` removed). Specs were updated accordingly (creation now posts `name: " bob "` and no usernames). If a client still POSTs the old nested envelope (`group: { name: ... }`), `params[:name]` will be nil, the controller will strip to `""` and `group.save` will fail, leading to `render_json_error group` (likely 422). This is a real, diff-grounded compatibility/regression concern, but may be an intentional breaking change rather than an unintended defect.
